title: Executive Order No. 92, s. 2025
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 92

CREATING THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENTIAL ADVISER ON
PASIG RIVER REHABILITATION AND REORGANIZING THE
INTER-AGENCY COUNCIL FOR THE PASIG RIVER URBAN
DEVELOPMENT

WHEREAS, Section 16, Article Il of the Constitution declares it a policy of the
State to protect and advance the right of the people to a balanced and healthful
ecology in accordance with the rhythm and harmony of nature;

WHEREAS, Executive Order (EO) No. 35 (s. 2023) established the
Inter-Agency Council for the Pasig River Urban Development (IAC-PRUD) to facilitate
and ensure the full rehabilitation of the banks along the Pasig River water system and
nearby water systems in order to provide alternative transportation, propel economic
opportunities, and boost tourism activities;

WHEREAS, the convergence of concerned government agencies is necessary
to rehabilitate and develop the Pasig River, a historically and culturally important
waterway, and to improve water quality, restore marine life, and develop its banks,
tributaries, and surrounding communities, all integral to the Administration’s urban
renewal strategy;

WHEREAS, considering the urgent and effective action required for the
rehabilitation of Pasig River, there is a need to create a dedicated office to oversee
and ensure the efficient, effective, and timely implementation of the rehabilitation and
development of the Pasig River;

WHEREAS, Section 31, Chapter 10, Title Ill, Book III of EO No. 292 or the
“Administrative Code of 1987” authorizes the President to reorganize the
administrative structure of the Office of the President (OP) in order to achieve
simplicity, economy, and efficiency;

WHEREAS, Section 93 of the General Provisions of Republic Act No. 12116 or
the “General Appropriations Act for Fiscal Year 2025” authorizes the President to
create new offices and modify the existing organizational structure of the agencies in
the Executive branch, as well as create new positions or modify existing ones
whenever public interest so requires; and

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
 
WHEREAS, Section 17, Article VII of the Constitution vests in the President the
power of control over all Executive departments, bureaus, and offices, and the
mandate to ensure the faithful execution of laws;

NOW THEREFORE, |, FERDINAND R. MARCOS, JR., President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing laws,
do hereby order:

Section 1. Creating the Office of the Presidential Adviser on Pasig River
Rehabilitation. The Office of the Presidential Adviser on Pasig River Rehabilitation
(OPAPRR) is hereby established under the OP. The OPAPRR shall be headed by the
Presidential Adviser for Pasig River Rehabilitation (PAPRR), appointed by the
President, with the rank and emoluments of a Secretary.

Section 2. Duties and Functions. The OPAPRR shall oversee and ensure the
efficient, effective, and timely implementation of the rehabilitation and development of
the Pasig River. To this end, the OPAPRR shall:

a. Advise the President on all matters regarding the formulation and implementation
of policies, plans, activities, and programs of the government towards the
rehabilitation, development, and restoration of the banks and tributaries along the
Pasig River water system and nearby water systems;

b. Monitor, coordinate, and harmonize all policies, plans, activities, and programs of
the Implementing Agencies in charge of the rehabilitation, development, and
restoration of the banks along the Pasig River water system and nearby water
systems;

c. Coordinate with concerned local government units (LGUs) in the implementation
of policies, plans, activities, and programs related to the Pasig River urban
development, subject to existing laws, rules and regulations;

d. Monitor the implementation of Presidential directives or priorities for the
rehabilitation, development, and restoration of the banks along the Pasig River
water system and nearby water systems, and coordinate with relevant agencies
in relation thereto;

e. As may be necessary, call upon any government department, agency, bureau, or
instrumentality, including government-owned or -controlled corporations
(GOCCs), and invite LGUs and representatives from the private sector to provide
assistance in attaining its objectives;

f. Submit a bi-annual report to the President, through the Office of the Executive
Secretary, on the status of the implementation of this Order; and

g. Perform such other functions as may be directed by the President and/or the
Executive Secretary.

Section 3. Organizational Structure and Staffing Pattern. The PAPRR shall
be supported by a staff complement who shall all possess the necessary background

 
and expertise in the field of river rehabilitation. The PAPRR, in coordination with the
Office of the Deputy Executive Secretary for Finance and Administration, shall
determine the appropriate organizational structure, staffing pattern, and corresponding
qualification standards for all positions in OPAPRR, and submit the same for review
and approval of the President and/or the Department of Budget and Management
(DBM), subject to existing laws, rules and regulations, including the Organization and
Staffing Standards and Guidelines issued by DBM and the Civil Service Commission.

Section 4. Reorganizing the Inter-Agency Council for the Pasig River
Urban Development. The IAC-PRUD is hereby reorganized and shall now be
composed of the following:

Chairperson : PAPPR
Vice Chairperson : Chairperson, Metropolitan Manila Development Authority
Members : Secretary, Department of Human Settlements and Urban

Development;
Secretary, Department of Public Works and Highways;
Secretary, Department of Environment and Natural Resources;
Secretary, Department of the Interior and Local Government;
Secretary, Department of Labor and Employment;
Secretary, Department of Tourism;
Secretary, Department of Transportation;
Secretary, Department of Finance;
Secretary, DBM;
Chairperson, National Historical Commission of the Philippines;
Chairperson, National Commission for Culture and the Arts;
General Manager, Philippine Ports Authority;
Commandant, Philippine Coast Guard;
General Manager, Laguna Lake Development Authority;
Chief Executive Officer, Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise
Zone Authority;
General Manager, National Housing Authority; and
General Manager, National Development Company.

The Secretariat of the IAC-PRUD shall be designated by the IAC-PRUD from
among the members thereof.

The Chairperson, Vice Chairperson, and members of the IAC-PRUD may
designate their alternates, with ranks not lower than Assistant Secretary or its
equivalent, who shall be fully authorized to decide for or on their behalf.

Section 5. Powers and Functions of the IAC-PRUD. The IAC-PRUD shall
continue to perform its duties and functions under Section 2 of EO No. 35. In addition
thereto, the IAC-PRUD, through its member-agencies, shall be authorized to accept
funding by way of entering into investment contracts or agreements with other
government agencies or private entities, subject to existing laws, rules and regulations.

Section 6. Convergence. All concerned government agencies are hereby
directed, and all LGUs and the private sector are hereby encouraged to render full
 
support and cooperation with the OPAPRR to ensure the effective implementation of
this Order.

Section 7. Funding. The funding requirements necessary for the
implementation of the Order shall be charged against the respective appropriations of
the concerned agencies and such other funding sources as may be identified by the
DBM. Thereafter, the funding requirements for the continued implementation of this
Order shall be included in the budget proposals of said agencies, subject to the usual
preparation process.

Section 8. Separability. If any part or provision of this Order is held invalid or
unconstitutional, the provisions not affected thereby shall remain in full force and
effect.

Section 9. Repeal. EO No. 35 is hereby amended. All other orders, rules and
regulations, and other issuances or parts thereof that are inconsistent with the
provisions of this Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Section 10. Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this 13th day of August , in the
Year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Five.
